cases.description: When the QUESTION section array entry is null, getQuestion() should return null.
When the QUESTION section contains an empty List<Record>, getQuestion() should return null.

group: Question section contains a single record

cases.description: After adding a single Record (recordA) to the QUESTION section via addRecord(..., Section.QUESTION), getQuestion() must return that same Record.
When multiple Records are added to the QUESTION section, getQuestion() should return the first Record that was added (index 0).

group: Question section becomes empty after removal

cases.description: Add a Record to the QUESTION section, verify getQuestion() returns it, then remove all records from the QUESTION section using removeAllRecords(...). After removal, getQuestion() must return null.
Create a Message, manually set the QUESTION section to a List containing a single null element. getQuestion() should return null because the first entry is null.

group: Message created via newQuery returns the query record

cases.description: Use Message.newQuery(record) to build a query Message. The method should place the supplied Record in the QUESTION section, so getQuestion() must return that same Record.

group: Message created via newUpdate returns null question

cases.description: Create a Message with Message.newUpdate(Name) which represents a dynamic update. Update messages do not have a QUESTION section; getQuestion() should therefore return null.

group: Question section unaffected by records in other sections

cases.description: Add a Record to the ANSWER section (or any non‑QUESTION section) and verify that getQuestion() still returns null because the QUESTION section remains empty.

group: Repeated calls to getQuestion return same instance

cases.description: Add a single Record to the QUESTION section, invoke getQuestion() twice and assert that both calls return the exact same object reference.

group: Removing the sole question record via removeRecord results in null

cases.description: Add one Record to the QUESTION section, confirm getQuestion() returns it, then call removeRecord(record, Section.QUESTION). After removal, getQuestion() must return null.
Directly set the private field `sections` of a Message instance to null (via reflection). Calling getQuestion() should throw NullPointerException because the method tries to index into a null array.

Create a Message and replace its internal `sections` array with a new List[0] (or any length smaller than the constant `Section.QUESTION`). Invoking getQuestion() attempts to access `sections[Section.QUESTION]` and must raise ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
